meaning: A person with many followers on social media. Companies may pay them, or give them free items, to show products.
clues: A person who posts photos and short videos for lots of followers.
They usually show and talk about things they like.
They got famous by posting on social media apps, and companies may pay them to show a product.
People follow them for tips on things like makeup, games, food, or travel.
It has ten letters and starts with I.
assumes: A blogger writes posts on a website
A celebrity is famous for acting, music, or sports
A moderator keeps an online group tidy

decoys.meaning: A person who writes posts on their own website, like an online journal.
A very famous person, known for work like acting, music, or sports.
A person who watches over an online group and removes posts that break the rules.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, ads were on cereal boxes and the radio. Now a friendly face sells things from the kitchen!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: if they are paid or get free items, they have to say so. Look for words like ad or sponsored.
